qa.answer: Four options. Air expedite the WO-2610 brackets and resource three later lines to cheaper approved sources (saves USD 40K net, no redelivery slip, recommended), air expedite the brackets only (USD 10K, no slip), re-sequence WO-2610 so the brackets fit late (no cost but high risk under rolling strikes), or accept the slip and pay 2 days of LDs to Selatan Air Charter (USD 4K, 2 day move).

The recommended option is the cheapest: Weser cascade segments are USD 1,074 below Garonne, Arden inlet lip skins USD 6,327 below and Cebu blocker doors USD 445 below, saving USD 50.3K across 21 parts. Net of USD 10K air freight on the brackets it saves USD 40.2K. Among options that touch only WO-2610, re-sequencing costs nothing but carries the most risk.

There is no close precedent for a labour strike at a nacelle supplier. The nearest is the 2023 Johor machine shop administration (PRE-02), where brackets and housings were resourced to India and took 6 weeks to requalify. Here the alternates are already approved, so no first-article inspection is needed.

WO-2610 needs 16 thrust reverser brackets at induction on 27 Oct. Garonne's rescheduled delivery lands them on 1 Nov, a 5 day slip against 3 days of work-order float, so the NS-9978 redelivery to Selatan Air Charter moves 2 days to 28 Nov. Prairie Composites is approved for the bracket but quotes 60 days, which is no help this side of December.
